## Checklist

- [ ] Every new claim in the docs maps to a command and a file it produces.
- [ ] New clues cite a source; new data files carry `_meta` (source, date, rows, licence).
- [ ] Scripts declare dependencies in the PEP 723 header and run with `uv run`.
- [ ] Nothing here identifies a real person, a private home, or the answer to a specific case.
- [ ] If `README.md` changed, the translated READMEs still match its structure and numbers (or say which ones you left behind).
